language.label: Interface language

hero.title: Know where your case stands. Without refreshing USCIS every day.
hero.subtitle: Kinstamp keeps the full history of every USCIS case your family tracks, explains each status in plain English or Spanish, and lets your attorney follow along.
hero.note: Free for families. Works with any USCIS receipt number.

preview.ariaLabel: Example of a case detail with its timeline
preview.caption: Example with a USCIS sandbox receipt.

benefits.title: Everything about a case, in one calm place.

history.title: The full history, kept for you
history.body: Every status USCIS reports, plus every change Kinstamp observes between checks, with its date. Nothing is ever edited or lost.

share.title: Share with your attorney
share.body: Grant access with their email. They see the case and its history, can refresh it and add key dates, and nothing more. Revoke anytime.

plain.title: Plain-language explanations
plain.body: What a status means and what usually comes next, in English and Spanish. Not legal advice, just clarity.

slow.title: Is my case slow?
slow.body: Compare your case's age with the processing time USCIS publishes for that form, with its source and date.

add.title: Add a case
add.body: Enter the receipt number from your notice and give the case a nickname.

check.title: We check USCIS
check.body: Refresh whenever you want. Kinstamp also checks on weekdays and emails you when something changes.

share.title: Share if you want
share.body: Your attorney sees only what you share, for as long as you want.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours.
privacy.body: Kinstamp only checks cases you add. Processing-time insights use anonymized data from people who opt in, and only for groups large enough that no case can be singled out.
